title: Drain the water
detail: Plug is at the bottom right side of every ice bath.
warning: Stand clear of the faucet before pulling the plug — pressure is high and releases in a flicking motion. Water can gush out and injure you if you're in the pressure point path.

substeps.text: Stand clear of faucet path before opening.
At half-empty and only in an open area, flip bath to dump remaining water.
Confirm pipes are unplugged before flipping/dumping.

title: Release the air
detail: Deflate the bath. Expect a sudden initial gush of air, then finish deflating manually.

title: Disconnect the pipes
detail: Remove the O-ring from the pipes and store it safely. Unscrew the pipes and set them aside.

substeps.text: Discard the primary filter (used = turns black); rinse with leftover water.
Wash and keep the secondary filter — it is not discarded.

title: Power off and relocate
detail: Power off the machine and move it to a safe area.

title: Fold the bath
detail: Fold the empty bath and set it aside.

title: Bag it up
detail: Pipes go in one bag, bath goes in a separate bag — or hand off to the collection team if present.

title: Daily maintenance close
detail: For a daily close (not a full pack-down): unplug the generator (no tubes attached) and put it on charge; detach the V-connector; rest the tubes on the chair; unzip the boots fully; wipe down with Febreze and a wet wipe.

title: Full close — disconnect the air-hole tube
detail: Do not undo the velcro strap over the 8-air-hole tube — disconnect it from the boot side instead.

title: Confirm packed inventory
detail: Final packed inventory: charger + wire, generator, V-connector, 2x tube, 2x boot. The chair is optional and packed separately — it is not part of the set.

title: Pack into the bag
detail: Pack order into the bag, in sequence.

title: Fold and bring to collection point
detail: Fold the chair and bring it to the collection point.

title: Misc bag contents
detail: Misc bag holds: tissues, charger ports, charger extensions, Febreze spray.
